purpose: Directly replay the best common-spherical closure-control compromise with eight lens-geometry starts.
claim_boundary: Universal gravity constants are copied unchanged from the common-spherical bridge fit.
No gravity constant is fitted to raw lensing.
Only pseudo-elliptical geometry, shear, center, and source positions are fitted to raw training images.
Candidates with missing held-out roots remain failures even when RMS over surviving roots is small.
This direct replay verifies a closure-control result selected after viewing earlier stages; it is not an independent holdout.
